_about: Fixed naming vocabulary for the elite capture (2026-11-03). Every label the extractor or the naming pass writes must come from these lists. Levels: page_type > region > block_type > component (ui_term) > element; copy_role labels each text run. ml_class = detection class used by Rico / WebUI / screen-parsing datasets so models trained on those can read our data.

levels.site: the brand's whole public estate (all hosts: www, docs, community, help)
levels.page_type: what job a page does in the brand's ecosystem (see page_types)
levels.region: top-level page band: header, hero, body section, sidebar rail, footer
levels.block: a self-contained section with one purpose (see block_types)
levels.component: a reusable UI part inside a block (see ui_terms); repeated components form a family
levels.element: one DOM node: text run, icon, image, control

page_types.home: root page; brand promise + routes into the ecosystem
page_types.product_overview: the whole product or platform explained
page_types.solution_by_role: the product framed for a job title / team
page_types.solution_by_industry: the product framed for a sector
page_types.use_case_detail: one concrete job-to-be-done with worked example
page_types.pricing: plans, tiers, comparison matrix, billing toggle, FAQ
page_types.alternatives: list of alternatives to a competitor
page_types.template_gallery: browsable grid of templates / examples / showcases
page_types.template_detail: one template / showcase item with preview + use
page_types.free_tool: a working utility used as acquisition (generator, converter, calculator)
page_types.docs_article: one documentation page (sidebar nav + content + on-page TOC)

block_types.hero_split: headline/CTA one side, media other side
block_types.hero_centered: centred headline, sub, CTA, media below
block_types.hero_product_ui: hero dominated by a product screenshot / live UI
block_types.logo_cloud: row/grid of customer or partner logos
block_types.stat_band: row of big numbers with labels
block_types.feature_grid: grid of feature cards (icon + title + text)
block_types.bento_grid: asymmetric grid of different-size feature tiles
block_types.product_tour_steps: numbered steps of how it works
block_types.feature_comparison_matrix: rows of features x plans/competitors with checks
block_types.gallery_grid: grid of templates / showcase cards with filters
block_types.code_block: code sample with copy button / language tabs
block_types.chart_panel: panel holding a chart with title/legend
block_types.profile_header: person/creator banner with avatar and actions

ui_terms.stat_tile: card whose main content is one big number + label
ui_terms.metric_row: label + value pair on one line
ui_terms.glyph_graphic: text characters used as a graphic
ui_terms.tooltip_callout: floating annotation box pointing at something

eyebrow_overline.desc: small uppercase spaced label above a headline

panel_label.desc: small uppercase label naming a card/panel (SYSTEM SCORE)

subheadline.desc: lead text directly under a headline

supporting_text.desc: short descriptive text in a card

unit_suffix.desc: unit or denominator after a number (/100, ms, %)

metric_label.desc: label of a metric row or stat

metric_value.desc: small number in a metric row

delta_indicator.desc: change vs period (+6 vs last 7 days)
